abstract: BACKGROUND: Fetus-in-fetu (FIF) is an extremely rare congenital abnormal mass, in which a normal fetus's vertebral axis frequently connected with malformed fetus around this axis. Here, we report the case of a male infant aged 26 d presenting with retroperitoneal parasitic fetus. CASE SUMMARY: In a prenatal examination, we first detected an abdominal mass measuring 7.8 cm × 5.1 cm × 6.8 cm in a mother's abdomen at 25 gestational weeks and teratoma was suspected. After the fetal was born, we did a magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) and ultrasonography on him and saw a distinctive limb with five-toes. According to the result of MRI, ultrasonography and postoperative pathology, he finally was diagnosed with FIF. CONCLUSION: A laparotomy was performed at 26 d of age with excision of the retroperitoneal cystic tumor, which measured about 10 cm in diameter. According to the result of imaging and histological test, FIF was confirmed.
abstract_ja: 背景：胎児内胎児(FIF)は極めて稀な先天性異常性腫瘤であり、正常胎児の脊柱軸に、その周囲の奇形胎児が連結していることが多い。本稿では、後腹膜寄生胎児を有する生後26日の男児の症例を報告する。症例概要：出生前検査において、妊娠25週の母体の腹部に7.8cm×5.1cm×6.8cmの腹部腫瘤が初めて検出され、奇形腫が疑われた。出生後、磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)と超音波検査を実施したところ、五指を有する特徴的な四肢が認められた。MRI、超音波検査、および術後病理の結果から、最終的にFIFと診断された。結論：生後26日時に開腹術を施行し、直径約10cmの後腹膜嚢胞性腫瘍を切除した。画像検査および組織学的検査の結果、FIFが確認された。
